headword: {冷静沈着|れいせいちんちゃく}
gloss: cool and composed; calm and collected

definitions.gloss: cool and composed; calm and collected
definitions.explanation: Describes a person who stays calm and level-headed under pressure, without panicking or showing emotional disturbance. A common four-character compound (yojijukugo) praising steady composure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷静沈着|れいせいちんちゃく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a cool and composed person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊急事態|きんきゅうじたい}→緊急事態：16936_kinkyuujitai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{冷静沈着|れいせいちんちゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧した。
examples.english: He responded calmly and composedly even in the emergency.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷静沈着|れいせいちんちゃく}な⟦{判断力|はんだんりょく}→判断力：17617_handanryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: This job requires calm, composed judgment.

notes:
YOJIJUKUGO (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧): combines ⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧ (calm) and ⟦{沈着|ちんちゃく}→沈着：09171_chinchaku⟧ (composed), two near-synonyms reinforcing each other. Praises someone who keeps a clear head in a crisis.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冷静沈着|れいせいちんちゃく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a cool-headed person
- {冷静沈着|れいせいちんちゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to respond calmly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明鏡止水|めいきょうしすい}→明鏡止水：07123_meikyoushisui⟧: a serene, undisturbed mind — more poetic, describes an inner mental state rather than behavior under pressure
- {泰然自若|たいぜんじじゃく}: unperturbed, imperturbable — closer in meaning, but rarer in everyday speech
